reason: The current LightGCN improves macro validation HR@10 from 0.505 to 0.5537, supporting retention of the collaborative architecture, but training profiles contain their own sampled positives and permit a self-similarity shortcut. Electronics declines from 0.42 to 0.33, motivating this controlled correction without establishing its cause. Modify model profile construction and its training-loop integration while retaining the historically successful graph propagation, BPR objective, and routed inference.

plan.model_design: Implement target-excluded training profiles while preserving LightGCN.training_vectors() and its existing return signature; add a helper for batch-specific correction using user indices, sampled positives, and the current differentiable item_vectors. For each sampled pair (u,p), retrieve the coalesced history_matrix weight a_up, which already aggregates every occurrence of p, and replace the inclusive profile h_u with (h_u - a_up * item_vectors[p]) / (1 - a_up). Use a safe denominator and explicitly return a zero profile when no other history items remain, retaining gradient flow through the corrected embedding calculation and avoiding batch-by-catalog dense allocations. Keep unchanged the two propagation layers, DIM=64, history coefficient 0.5, half-life of 10 interactions, training graph, PredictionModel.forward(), export format, and inference profiles.
plan.training_evaluation: In train_dataset(), use the corrected batch user representations for both positive and negative scores in the existing BPR difference, preserving train_dataset(ds, device, deadline), variable names, sampling, regularization, optimizer, epoch limit, and checkpoint selection. Add lightweight deterministic checks for repeated positives, single-item histories, histories containing only repetitions of the positive, and equivalence to an explicitly filtered weighted average; ensure these checks do not alter training RNG state. Keep preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, supplied splits, DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], all four categories, single-GPU execution, trial-local artifacts, and the existing predictor writer unchanged because exported inference architecture and scoring remain compatible. Evaluate with the unchanged pinned validation protocol of 200 users per category, 99 unique negatives, and seed 42, comparing macro HR@10 against 0.5537 and Electronics against 0.33 as hypotheses rather than promised improvements, without accessing hidden test data.
